 This Petition, Coming On For Preliminary Hearing
In 'B' Group, This Day, Order Was Made Therein As

Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice E.S.Indiresh

In this writ petition, the petitioner claims to be the owner of subject land and same was the subject matter of acquisition made by respondent - authority for the purpose of formation of Dr.
Shivarama Karanth Layout.

2. The case of the petitioner herein is that petitioner has received notices under Section 12(2) of the Land Acquisition NC: 2024:KHC:44587 Act, 1894, in respect of the schedule properties indicating the compensation to be awarded in favour of the petitioner.
It is stated in the writ petition that petitioner has filed reply to the notices referred to at Annexures - A, B and C, as per his representations produced at Annexure- E, F and G respectively.

3. Having heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties, it is not in dispute that the petitioner has made representation dated 15.04.2023 as per Annexure-E, F and G, seeking response from the respondent - authority to refer the matter to competent authority under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act.

sentences.text: 4. The Division Bench of this Court in identical matter in W.P.No.9113/2024, disposed of the matter on 20.09.2024, directing the respondent - authority to consider the representation seeking referring the matter to competent Court under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, within four weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of the order.

5. In that view of the matter, following the observation made by the Division Bench of this Court as stated above, the present Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondent - NC: 2024:KHC:44587 BDA to consider the representation seeking reference of the matter to competent Court under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, as per Annexures - E, F and G and pass appropriate order in accordance with law, within four weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.

SD/-
